mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( name, slug, description, display_type, status, sort_order, created_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{slug}, #{description}, #{displayType}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO board_policy ( board_id, read_permission, write_permission, comment_permission, secret_mode, categories_enabled, category_required, attachments_enabled, upload_profile, max_file_count, max_file_size_bytes, image_required, thumbnail_enabled, representative_image_mode, comments_enabled, comment_replies_enabled, post_likes_enabled, comment_likes_enabled, official_reply_enabled, version ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{readPermission}, #{writePermission}, #{commentPermission}, #{secretMode}, #{categoriesEnabled}, #{categoryRequired}, #{attachmentsEnabled}, #{uploadProfile}, #{maxFileCount}, #{maxFileSizeBytes}, #{imageRequired}, #{thumbnailEnabled}, #{representativeImageMode}, #{commentsEnabled}, #{commentRepliesEnabled}, #{postLikesEnabled}, #{commentLikesEnabled}, #{officialReplyEnabled}, #{version} )
INSERT INTO board_category ( board_id, name, sort_order, active ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{active} )
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.slug, b.description, b.display_type AS displayType, b.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM board b INNER JOIN board_policy bp ON bp.board_id = b.id WHERE b.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( bp.read_permission = 'PUBLIC'
OR bp.read_permission = 'MEMBER'
OR bp.read_permission = 'ADMIN'
) ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.id ASC
SELECT id, name, slug, description, display_type, status, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM board WHERE slug = #{slug} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT board_id, read_permission, write_permission, comment_permission, secret_mode, categories_enabled, category_required, attachments_enabled, upload_profile, max_file_count, max_file_size_bytes, image_required, thumbnail_enabled, representative_image_mode, comments_enabled, comment_replies_enabled, post_likes_enabled, comment_likes_enabled, official_reply_enabled, version, updated_at FROM board_policy WHERE board_id = #{boardId}
SELECT id, board_id, name, sort_order, active FROM board_category WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
